answer: An umber audit garden: each identity must forge one bond receipt per epoch, and a garden of independent auditors must sign it before close. The k-th bond from one funder locks 3k^2 stake until the audit clears: 10 fakes lock 1,155, 100 lock 1,015,050. Bonds sharing one funder audit trail are slashed together, so cloning the same trail multiplies the loss.
